blocks.sig: say what would you say? take turns to say your answer. then tap “show the answer”.
game memo: look at the phrases for 40 seconds and try to remember them. then they disappear: take turns and say one each.
sort sort it: say each line in english, then tap to check and put it in its box.
fix fix it: say it right. then say the two lines with “only seen”.
fix fix it: say it right. then ask the two questions with “any good”.
game how to play: b has a secret card, and a guesses what's on it. then swap.
questions round 2: your own series and films. play the same game.

questions.6.sig: 1 think of a series or film you loved — and one you gave up on or couldn't get into.
2 your partner asks: have you seen…? is it any good? tell your partner about it, but don't use the box phrase — let them guess it.
3 at the end, tell each other what you'll give a try — and what you won't bother with.
